provenance.note: Measured proof that --warning could not power a skip count under --json (#3436). A workspace with one unresolvable LOCAL import is present, so a usable warning channel would emit it; stderr is EMPTY because bin/cli.js:195 gates --warning on !program.json. The SAME argv WITHOUT --json printed `✖ Skipped 1 file` and `./missing.js` to STDOUT, where --json would have been corrupted — so `parseMadgeSkips(result.stderr)` could only ever return `{ total: 0, local: [] }` and `localSkips` was structurally 0. The client's argv no longer passes --warning.
